description: Byte cost of each CellPack design step, from native CSR to packed .cpk chunks, on 4096-cell chunks of CELLxGENE matrices (CellPack-lab/data/cellxgene-10m). Each sampled stored chunk is decoded to source CSR and re-encoded with the cellpack crate under option sets that enable one mechanism at a time. Steps are cumulative; ratio_vs_previous is each step over the one before.
exactness: Every number is exact encoder output or exact arithmetic; nothing is estimated. The writer-default re-encode of all sampled chunks is bit-identical to the stored chunks (bit_exact_reencode=1 for all). Index and value section bytes are obtained by subtraction: index = record - header - raw values (values forced raw); value = record - header - index, with the gap model and gene order asserted identical across the runs. Steps 2-6 force the sparse layout (no dense records occurred under auto either).

method.options: max_lanes 32, lane_min 32, index/value thresholds 0.6, column-mode share 0.5 (crate defaults); chunks of 4096 rows; 4 KiB pages
method.note_versions: stored files carry pre-reset version numbers (cpk 2, chunk 3); they are read directly with the version field patched, layouts unchanged (verified by bit-exact re-encode)

steps.what: Native CSR: u64 indptr + u32 indices + f32 values
steps.how: exact (arithmetic)

steps.what: CSR with 2-byte column ids (all sampled matrices have <= 65536 genes)
steps.how: exact (arithmetic)

steps.what: CSR with u16 ids and the stored value dtype (u16 counts for raw, f32 for normed)
steps.how: exact (arithmetic)

steps.what: One record per cell: flags + nnz varint + raw u16 ids + raw values (no indptr)
steps.how: exact encoder output (renumber off, thresholds 0, values raw, sparse layout)

steps.what: Index sections gap-coded in source column order with the shared per-chunk rANS gap table
steps.how: exact encoder output (renumber off, default index threshold 0.6, values raw)

steps.what: Genes renumbered by per-chunk presence, then gap-coded
steps.how: exact encoder output (renumber on, values raw)

steps.what: Values dictionary-coded (distinct bit patterns + rANS ranks), per-record choice vs raw
steps.how: exact encoder output (values auto, no column modes)

steps.what: Column-mode coding offered (rank 0 = gene's per-chunk mode); writer default: floats only, chunk builds the table only when it pays
steps.how: exact encoder output (raw: = step 5, since CpkWriter disables modes for integer dtypes; normed: values auto + column_modes 0.5)

steps.what: + chunk metadata (header, 3 rANS tables, gene permutation, modes, offsets, lengths, kinds, cumulative nnz)
steps.how: exact (writer-default chunk, layout auto; metadata = meta_len)

steps.what: + page packing to 4 KiB (padding so each record reads its minimum number of pages)
steps.how: exact (packed_len; re-encoded chunks are bit-identical to the stored chunks)

steps.what: + file overhead: chunk alignment to 4 KiB + 4 KiB superblock + 40 B/chunk directory, amortized per chunk
steps.how: exact amortization of the real files

value_column_modes_auto_all_dtypes.note: column modes offered to every chunk, incl. integer counts (the writer does not do this for integers)

value_column_modes_forced.note: every record mode-coded against an always-built table (table bytes not included here)

page_padding.note: includes padding the metadata to the first page boundary

contrast.note: Shared per-chunk statistics vs per-cell compression. All record-level numbers exclude page padding.

per_cell_rans_records_only.how: exact encoder output: every cell encoded as its own 1-cell chunk (own rANS tables fitted to that cell; no renumbering, no modes); record bytes only, i.e. as if the per-cell tables were free

per_cell_rans_with_own_metadata.how: same, plus each 1-cell chunk's metadata (64 B header + 1536 B tables + per-cell tables); the format's tables are fixed-size, so this overstates a compact per-cell table

zstd3_per_cell.how: zstd level 3 on each cell's u16 source ids + stored-dtype values (no header)

zstd3_whole_chunk.how: zstd level 3 over the whole chunk (u64 indptr + per-cell u16 ids + values): no per-cell random access
